copy_material: create a deep copy of a Magnum MaterialData object with owned and mutable attribute data flags
filter_material_attributes: filter material attributes using a BitArray mask to keep or remove specific attributes from a MaterialData object
filter_material_layers: filter material layers using a BitArray mask to keep or remove specific layers from a MaterialData object
merge_materials: merge two MaterialData objects into one using a conflict resolution strategy like KEEP_FIRST_IF_SAME_TYPE
convert_phong_to_pbr: convert a Phong material to PBR metallic roughness format using phong_to_pbr_metallic_roughness with optional fail flags
